name: data-database-pagination-updated-runtime

args: Datetime startWindow=Datetime.now().addMinutes(-1); Account activeOne=new Account(Name='Active One'); insert activeOne; Account activeTwo=new Account(Name='Active Two'); insert activeTwo; Account deleted=new Account(Name='Deleted Row'); insert deleted; delete deleted; Account updated=new Account(Name='Updated Before'); insert updated; updated.Name='Updated After'; update updated; Datetime endWindow=Datetime.now().addMinutes(1); String query='SELECT Id,Name FROM Account'; Database.PaginationCursor cursor=new Database.PaginationCursor(); System.assertEquals(0,cursor.getNumRecords()); Database.PaginationCursor plain=Database.getPaginationCursor(query); System.assertEquals(3,plain.getNumRecords()); Database.CursorFetchResult page=plain.fetchPage(0,2); System.assertEquals(2,page.getRecords().size()); System.assertEquals(2,page.getNextIndex()); System.assert(!page.isDone()); Database.PaginationCursor access=Database.getPaginationCursor(query,AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assertEquals(3,access.getNumRecords()); Map<String,Object> binds=new Map<String,Object>(); binds.put('wanted','Updated After'); Database.PaginationCursor boundAccess=Database.getPaginationCursorWithBinds('SELECT Id,Name FROM Account WHERE Name=:wanted',binds,AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assertEquals(1,boundAccess.getNumRecords()); Database.GetUpdatedResult changed=Database.getUpdated('Account',startWindow,endWindow); System.assert(changed.getIds().contains(updated.Id)); System.assertNotEquals(null,changed.getLatestDateCovered()); List<Account> fresh=[SELECT Id,Name FROM Account WHERE Id=:updated.Id]; System.assertEquals('Updated After',fresh[0].Name); cursor=null; plain=null; access=null; boundAccess=null; changed=null; page=null;

salesforceExclusionReason: Pagination cursor and updated-window behavior are exercised against deterministic local active, deleted, and updated records; this fixture makes no hosted Salesforce parity claim.
